title: Unilever
subtitle: Unilever Future Leaders Programme (UFLP) – Supply Chain
summary: A three-year accelerated leadership programme spanning manufacturing, integrated planning, customer experience, and logistics. Led production teams, delivered process improvements, and built tools to support operational decisions.

sections.title: Manufacturing Excellence Executive
sections.body:
**Feb 2024 – Jun 2024**

Led the Dressings site’s Focused Improvement team, driving operational and process-improvement projects toward waste, efficiency, and cost targets.

sections.title: Process Engineer
sections.body:
**Sep 2023 – Jan 2024**

- Applied Focused Improvement principles to address line-efficiency losses, achieving a **19% sustained efficiency improvement**.
- Achieved **99% service level** during peak season.
- Led a pilot cell team of **3 operators, 1 Focused Improvement engineer, and 1 PM engineer**.

sections.title: First Line Manager
sections.body:
**Feb 2023 – Sep 2023**

- Managed a **70-person production-floor team** through the ramp-up of a newly launched factory, achieving **100% factory service level**.
- Developed a product-monitoring tool to improve planning and shorten time to action.

sections.title: Demand Excellence & Special Projects
sections.body:
**Integrated Planning · Apr 2022 – Oct 2022**

- Managed the initial to middle phases of a national demand dashboard combining sales, demand, supply, and customer data.
- Analyzed demand data to maintain and improve forecast accuracy and bias.
- Standardized and deployed the SKU rationalization process by improving indicators and process flow.

sections.title: VMI & Improvement Projects
sections.body:
**Customer Experience and Logistics · Aug 2021 – Mar 2022**

- Designed and built **Project Snowden**, a semi-automatic data-analysis tool for customer-service insights, contributing to **92.5% secondary service level during Aug–Dec 2021**.
- Managed the soft launch of **Locus**, a digital delivery-tracking system, across selected inbound and outbound truckers.
- Managed inventory replenishment and provided service insights to business customers.

sections.title: Data tools across rotations
sections.body: Delivered cross-functional projects, including a Python and Power BI tool that increased service level from **78% to 90%**.
